findings.finding: The plan asserts 'DIVERGENCE_INCOMPLETE_CONTRIB stays strictly below every blocking block_threshold … pinned by tests/unit/test_impact_plan.py' (and decide.py:347-349 repeats this attribution). A search of tests/unit/test_impact_plan.py returns zero hits for 'DIVERGENCE_INCOMPLETE_CONTRIB'. This is an incorrect file citation for a load-bearing invariant: the Testing section says the test suite for this ticket runs test_impact_plan.py, so a developer relying on that file to confirm the invariant is live will be misled.

findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Specify how G7 is added to the `test_threshold_recalibration.py` blocking-set union (e.g. introduce a separate `G7_BLOCKING = {"G7": 0.85}` constant analogous to PILOT_BLOCKING, update the parametrized threshold assertion to include it, and add `set(G7_BLOCKING)` to the set-union expression in `test_only_the_approved_and_prerequisite_criteria_are_blocking`).
evidence: Plan: 'tests/unit/test_threshold_recalibration.py EXPECTED_ROUTING ("G7": (0.85, "blocking")) and the blocking-set assertion (PILOT_BLOCKING-style entry)'
test_threshold_recalibration.py line 163: expected = LOWERED | set(PROMOTED) | set(PILOT_BLOCKING) | {"T4", "prerequisite-consistency"}
G7 block_threshold is 0.85, not 0.90, so it cannot enter PILOT_BLOCKING without changing the parametrized threshold assertion's expected value
findings.finding: The blocking-set assertion in test_threshold_recalibration.py (line 163) computes its expected set as `LOWERED | set(PROMOTED) | set(PILOT_BLOCKING) | {"T4", "prerequisite-consistency"}`. The plan says to add a 'PILOT_BLOCKING-style entry' for G7, but the existing PILOT_BLOCKING dict maps T3/T10/T5c → 0.90; G7 is at 0.85. Adding G7 to PILOT_BLOCKING would break the parametrized test_routing_posture_blocking_at_090 (which iterates PILOT_BLOCKING and asserts block_threshold == 0.9). The plan does not specify which constant or set expression carries G7 in the blocking-set union, leaving an unenumerated consumer of PILOT_BLOCKING's semantics.
scenarios: Implementer adds G7 to PILOT_BLOCKING → test_routing_posture_blocking_at_090 fails on G7 (asserts 0.9, gets 0.85)
Implementer adds G7 via a new constant not included in the set-union expression → blocking-set assertion still fails (G7 is blocking but not in expected set)
Either path produces a test failure the plan does not anticipate, blocking the AC that requires all three pinned assertions to include G7
findings.suggested_fix: Add `G7_BLOCKING = {"G7": 0.85}` below PILOT_BLOCKING; extend the `@pytest.mark.parametrize` on `test_routing_posture_blocking_at_090` to also cover `G7_BLOCKING` entries with their correct threshold (0.85); and update line 163 to `expected = LOWERED | set(PROMOTED) | set(PILOT_BLOCKING) | set(G7_BLOCKING) | {"T4", "prerequisite-consistency"}`.
